paths.description: Homepage and mandatory age gate: entry purpose, preferences, navigation, load, privacy, discoverability, and memory baseline.
AI search results listing: representative long content/catalog template and mobile navigation.
Representative video detail route: media/detail template and mobile reflow. Playback was not started to avoid unnecessary media transfer.
Account sign-in/sign-up/recovery template: forms, focus, autocomplete, authentication, and consent.
Deliberate nonexistent route: HTTP/application recovery state.

findings.summary: The interface ignores the system colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule, and the dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance to the default age gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven surface/text tokens, using light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme fallback.

findings.summary: No authored high-contrast or forced-colours adaptation is present.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found neither prefers-contrast nor forced-colors handling; essential custom controls rely on fixed blue/white styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast rules that preserve borders, focus indicators, text, and scrollbar visibility.

findings.summary: Route and state changes use abrupt swaps rather than directional view transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS/DOM probe found no view-transition usage across the home, search, and account templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with cross-document View Transitions and directional cues, retaining instant navigation as fallback.

findings.summary: Long listing chrome does not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: The search template is a long paginated feed, but CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query, progress cue, or responsive shrinking-header behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries for a compact sticky header or a lightweight progress/scrollability cue.

findings.summary: Menus and transient header controls are not anchored with resilient platform positioning.
findings.evidence: The templates expose menu/filter controls, while CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, position-try, or native popover usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement transient menus with popover and CSS anchor positioning plus position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not provide an attention cue.
findings.evidence: The home-to-search-to-detail journey uses full page swaps; no view-transition, highlight, scroll-marker, or other focus-movement cue was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add directional View Transitions and move focus to the destination heading after route changes.

findings.summary: The mandatory age gate is a custom full-screen div rather than a semantic modal.
findings.evidence: The visible gate is #disclaimer_background with three buttons; DOM inspection found zero dialog elements and the background page remains a large underlying interaction surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate as a modal <dialog>, move initial focus inside it, mark the rest inert, and define an explicit dismissal policy appropriate to age verification.

findings.summary: Dense navigation chrome competes with the listing content on mobile.
findings.evidence: The 360px search screenshot shows two stacked header bars, seven icon controls, filter/report chrome, and the age gate before the first result.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate secondary controls behind a labelled menu and keep the primary search/content actions visually dominant.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and controls rely on viewport rules rather than component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across home, search, and account templates found no @container or container-type usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable card/form regions and use size container queries for local layout changes, with existing viewport styles as fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not reliably visible and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The focused required account field computed outline-style:none; probes counted 151 sub-44px targets on search and 19 on account.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible outline and enlarge interactive hit areas to at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels where feasible.

findings.summary: The measured mobile load misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 5.8s and Time to Interactive 10.2s (performance 0.75), despite low CLS and TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, remove render-blocking work, and defer non-critical scripts and below-fold thumbnails.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is slowed by blocking resources and weak cache/font/image delivery.
findings.evidence: The HAR summary identifies one parser-blocking stylesheet and four parser-inserted script candidates; Lighthouse estimates 1.25s render-blocking savings and 4.9MiB cache-lifetime savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical classic scripts, set long immutable caching on versioned assets, and use font-display with suitable fallbacks.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 386KiB unused JavaScript, 123KiB unused CSS, and 51KiB legacy-JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template-specific bundles, remove dead/duplicate rules, and serve a modern module build without avoidable legacy transforms.

findings.summary: Important buttons and links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed button-name and link-name; the DOM probe found an unnamed account icon, logo link, and many image-only thumbnail links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give icon controls aria-labels or visible text, ensure thumbnail links derive names from adjacent titles, and preserve native semantics.

findings.summary: Heading/landmark structure and focus treatment are inconsistent.
findings.evidence: The homepage has no h1, the account page starts at repeated h2 headings, and the focused account field reports outline-style:none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive h1 per template, a main landmark, sequential headings, a skip link, and a persistent :focus-visible indicator.

findings.summary: Zoom policy and small targets reduce inclusive input access.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because scaling is constrained in its audited DOM, while the probes counted hundreds of controls below 44px; mobile reflow itself showed no horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow unrestricted user scaling, enlarge targets, and verify captions/equivalents on every video template.

findings.summary: Image assets are unsized and not responsively delivered.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 100/100 images without width/height, 100 without srcset, 100 legacy-format images, and 11 oversized images; Lighthouse also failed unsized-images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height, generate srcset/sizes, and serve AVIF/WebP with a compatible fallback.

findings.summary: Large first-party scripts ship without valid source maps.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed valid-source-maps for large first-party JavaScript; no console errors or deprecated API failures were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish matching production source maps with restricted access if needed, and keep build metadata aligned with deployed bundles.

findings.summary: Canonical and localization signals are incomplete and the sitemap host is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found no canonical or hreflang on the .es templates; https://www.xnxx.es/sitemap.xml lists only www.xnxx.com sitemap locations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-consistent canonical and hreflang alternates for localized pages and publish a host-consistent sitemap referenced by robots.txt.

findings.summary: Public listing/detail templates lack verified rich/share metadata.
findings.evidence: The representative probes found titles/descriptions but no visible evidence of Open Graph, Twitter Card, or validated schema.org entity metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter metadata and VideoObject/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD matching visible page content.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but the CSP and cookie/header posture are weaker than the baseline.
findings.evidence: Header evidence shows CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval, HSTS and nosniff are absent; the 180-day session_token uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP nonces/hashes without unsafe-eval, add HSTS and nosniff, and use Lax/Strict for the first-party session cookie unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Third-party delivery occurs before any recorded preference choice.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 13 third-party requests and 346,610 transferred bytes, including www.tjk-njk.com; the tracker primitive found two third-party origins even though no known tracker signature matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Document each third party, gate non-essential requests on consent, proxy or remove unnecessary calls, and batch analytics.

findings.summary: Account authentication is password-only and does not expose passkeys.
findings.evidence: The account probe found password sign-in fields and no WebAuthn/PublicKeyCredential integration; required sign-in fields also omit current-password/username autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside recovery-safe password fallback, and add correct sign-in autocomplete tokens.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent or weak.
findings.evidence: Headers show no HSTS, Permissions-Policy, or nosniff; Referrer-Policy is no-referrer-when-downgrade and CSP relies on X-Frame-Options rather than a visible frame-ancestors directive.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, Permissions-Policy, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter), and CSP frame-ancestors; assess Trusted Types for script-heavy surfaces.

findings.summary: Most rendered content is unavailable to a crawler that does not execute JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 31% raw-to-rendered content coverage and reported the rendered title absent from raw HTML, despite a 200 response.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render essential listings, titles, and navigation; use JavaScript to enhance sorting, personalization, and playback rather than create core text.

findings.summary: The standalone manifest is incomplete and there is no active service worker.
findings.evidence: The PWA probe found zero service-worker registrations; manifest.json has name/icons/display but no start_url and no offline fallback was demonstrated.
findings.suggestedFix: If standalone installation is intended, add start_url/scope/id, register a service worker, and provide an explicit offline fallback; otherwise remove misleading standalone intent.

findings.summary: Language is declared, but the layout is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: All sampled pages correctly use lang=es, yet CSS inspection found no logical inline/block properties and no dir declaration across a site with language switching.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain correct lang, set direction from locale, and replace physical left/right spacing and positioning with logical properties.

findings.summary: Sign-up, sign-in, and recovery fields omit useful autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The account probe found empty autocomplete on email/login/password fields except new-password confirmation fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username, email, current-password, new-password, and profile-appropriate tokens on the corresponding controls.

findings.summary: The thumbnail-heavy experience does not optimise image formats or responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 100 legacy PNG/JPEG images, zero modern-format images, zero srcset, 11 oversized images, and 89 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, use picture/srcset/sizes, set dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails while keeping the LCP image eager.

findings.summary: Large unused bundles and eager below-fold image work waste network and processing resources.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 509KiB unused CSS/JS and the image audit found 89 below-fold images not marked lazy.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused bundle code, conditionally load template features, and defer below-fold image/rendering work with loading=lazy and content-visibility where suitable.

taskList.title: Make the age gate a keyboard-safe semantic modal and repair names/focus/targets
Fix LCP and critical resource delivery; remove unused and legacy bundles
Harden CSP, transport headers, browser policies, cookies, and third-party gating
Add passkeys and correct account autocomplete tokens
Build a responsive modern-image pipeline with dimensions, srcset, formats, and lazy loading
Server-render core catalog content and complete install/offline intent
Add canonical, hreflang, sitemap consistency, and rich share metadata
Add preference-responsive theme and contrast styles
Simplify mobile chrome and progressively enhance navigation cues/positioning
Adopt container queries and logical properties for reusable/localized layouts
